text: Soon whispers about the lovers. <break time="0.8s" /> Spread among the people. <break time="0.8s" /> And enemies began to watch them. <break time="0.8s" /> Until at last Arsats brother told him. <break time="0.8s" /> That he must take the woman away. <break time="0.8s" /> The chance came on a night. <break time="0.8s" /> When the Ruler and all his people. <break time="0.8s" /> Went down to the mouth of the river. <break time="0.8s" /> To catch fish. <break time="0.8s" /> By the light of countless torches. <break time="0.8s" /> While the crowd was busy with the fishing. <break time="0.8s" /> The brothers slipped away. <break time="0.8s" /> In a small canoe. <break time="0.8s" /> And Diamelen came running toward them. <break time="0.8s" /> Along the dark shore. <break time="0.8s" /> Arsat lifted her into the canoe. <break time="0.8s" /> And the brothers paddled with all their strength. <break time="0.8s" /> Down the river and out to the open sea. <break time="0.8s" /> Hardly speaking a word all night. <break time="0.8s" /> When the sun rose. <break time="0.8s" /> They were moving along the coast. <break time="0.8s" /> And Arsats brother would not let them rest. <break time="0.8s" /> For he knew. <break time="0.8s" /> That the Rulers men would soon be after them. <break time="0.8s" /> Not until the sun was high. <break time="0.8s" /> Did Arsat, exhausted, beg for a short rest. <break time="0.8s" /> And his brother at last agreed. <break time="0.8s" /> To stop in a bay of white sand. <break time="0.8s" /> Near a cape. <break time="0.8s" /> Diamelen had hardly fallen asleep on the sand. <break time="0.8s" /> When she woke with a cry. <break time="0.8s" /> For a boat of the Rulers men. <break time="0.8s" /> Was coming toward the bay. <break time="0.8s" /> Its gong sounding across the water. <break time="0.8s" /> Arsats brother carried a gun. <break time="0.8s" /> That the white man had once given him. <break time="0.8s" /> Though he had only a handful of powder. <break time="0.8s" /> And he quickly made a plan. <break time="0.8s" /> To save the others. <break time="0.8s" /> Run through the forest. <break time="0.8s" /> To the fishermans hut on the other side. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> And take his canoe. <break time="0.8s" /> While I hold them back here. <break time="0.8s" /> And then I will follow you.
